beats.title: PR Merged with Owner Refinements
beats.body: The owner accepted the contribution, applied bug fixes and refactoring before merging on April 3, 2022. The design introduced an abstraction layer for recording so third-party muxers could be plugged in without touching core library code. The default implementation remained unchanged, preserving backward compatibility.

beats.title: Engineering Lessons
lessons: Introducing an abstraction layer for a concrete subsystem lets external contributors extend behavior without forking or modifying core code.
Accepting a contribution while reserving the right to refactor before merging balances community openness with codebase quality standards.
Supporting all partial-input modes (audio-only, video-only, both) from the start prevents fragile assumptions that break real-world edge cases.
